fusions.name: Held Release
fusions.desc: After holding the draw for 1.2 seconds, fires a round at an enemy up to 11 tiles away that deals 30 damage and always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: String and Powder
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow and fires a round together, each dealing 5 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Full Draw
fusions.desc: Your critical hits deal 30% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Mounting Tension
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. Your next critical hit spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
